next:or:608.hint: 昨年と比較して、売り上げは改善した
next:or:608.fullSentence: In comparison with last year, sales have improved.
next:or:608.explanation: in comparison with A『Aと比較して』。
next:or:608.relatedInfo: comparedとほぼ同じ意味で使う。

next:or:609.hint: 優先順位を表す前置詞句
next:or:609.question: He chose design [[in preference of]] comfort.
next:or:609.fullSentence: He chose design in preference to comfort.
next:or:609.explanation: in preference to A『Aよりも優先して』。
next:or:609.relatedInfo: 比較対象を示すtoを使う点に注意。

next:or:610.hint: あなたの質問に関しては、確認してご連絡します
next:or:610.fullSentence: In regard to your question, I will check and get back to you.
next:or:610.explanation: in regard to A『Aに関して』。
next:or:610.relatedInfo: with regard to Aとも言う。

next:or:611.hint: お礼・見返りを表す前置詞句
next:or:611.question: [[In return of]] his help, I treated him to dinner.
next:or:611.fullSentence: In return for his help, I treated him to dinner.
next:or:611.explanation: in return for A『Aのお返しに』。
next:or:611.relatedInfo: forは対価・見返りを示す。

next:or:612.hint: 彼らは自由のために戦った
next:or:612.fullSentence: They fought for the sake of freedom.
next:or:612.explanation: for the sake of A『Aのために』。

next:or:613.hint: 不足を理由とする前置詞句
next:or:613.question: The project was canceled [[for a lack in]] funds.
next:or:613.fullSentence: The project was canceled for lack of funds.
next:or:613.explanation: for lack of A『Aの不足のために』。

next:or:614.hint: 赤ちゃんを起こさないように、彼はささやいた
next:or:614.fullSentence: He whispered for fear of waking the baby.
next:or:614.explanation: for fear of doing『〜しないように』。for fear of A『Aを恐れて』も同じ形。
next:or:614.relatedInfo: for fear that S should doとほぼ同義。

next:or:615.hint: 見た瞬間の反応を表す前置詞句
next:or:615.question: She wept [[in the sight of]] her house.
next:or:615.fullSentence: She wept at the sight of her house.
next:or:615.explanation: at the sight of A『Aを見ると』。
next:or:615.relatedInfo: 見た瞬間の即座の反応を表す。

next:or:616.hint: 生存者たちは海のなすがままだった
next:or:616.fullSentence: The survivors were at the mercy of the sea.
next:or:616.explanation: at the mercy of A『Aのなすがままに』。
next:or:616.relatedInfo: IMG_0722でも扱った表現の再確認。

next:or:617.hint: 何かを失う代償を表す前置詞句
next:or:617.question: He worked [[at the cost for]] his health.
next:or:617.fullSentence: He worked at the expense of his health.
next:or:617.explanation: at the expense/cost of A『Aを犠牲にして』。
next:or:617.relatedInfo: expense/costどちらも同じ意味で使える。

next:or:618.hint: 彼はすべてを失う危険を賭けて、貯金全てを投資した
next:or:618.fullSentence: He invested all his savings at the risk of losing everything.
next:or:618.explanation: at the risk of A『Aを賭けて、Aの危険を冒して』。
next:or:618.relatedInfo: IMG_0722でも扱った表現の再確認。

next:or:619.hint: 手段を表すやや堅い前置詞句
next:or:619.question: They communicated [[by the means to]] gestures.
next:or:619.fullSentence: They communicated by means of gestures.
next:or:619.explanation: by means of A『Aを用いて、Aによって』。
next:or:619.relatedInfo: throughとも近い意味だが、より手段を明確に示す。

next:or:620.hint: 私を除いて全員が遅刻した
next:or:620.explanation: A except B『AがBを除いて(Bは範囲外)』。
next:or:620.relatedInfo: exceptは動詞の後に直接置ける。

next:or:621.hint: 1点だけを除外する前置詞句
next:or:621.question: Everything was perfect [[except of]] your attitude.
next:or:621.fullSentence: Everything was perfect except for your attitude.
next:or:621.relatedInfo: 文頭にも置ける点でexceptより柔軟。

next:or:622.hint: 一人の会員を除いて全員が出席した
next:or:622.fullSentence: All were present save one member.
next:or:622.explanation: save ~『〜を除いて』。文語的な表現。
next:or:622.relatedInfo: exceptとほぼ同義だがやや堅い。

next:or:623.hint: 1つを除く全部を表す慣用句
next:or:623.fullSentence: All but one of the cakes were sold.
next:or:623.explanation: all but one『一つを除いて全部』。
next:or:623.relatedInfo: butがexceptの意味で使われる用法。

next:or:624.hint: 医者を除いて誰も真実を知らなかった
next:or:624.fullSentence: No one knew the truth other than the doctor.
next:or:624.explanation: other than A『Aを除いて、A以外は』。

next:or:625.hint: 最後を基準にした序数的な表現
next:or:625.question: This is [[the last one station]].
next:or:625.fullSentence: This is the last station but one.
next:or:625.explanation: the last A but one『最後から2番目のA』。
next:or:625.relatedInfo: butが『〜を除いて』の意味を持つ慣用句。

next:or:626.hint: 日本に加えて、私は他の多くの国にも行ったことがある
next:or:626.fullSentence: Besides Japan, I have also been to a lot of countries.
next:or:626.explanation: besides『〜に加えて』。追加を表す前置詞。
next:or:626.relatedInfo: beside(そばに)とスペルが似ているが意味が異なる。

next:or:627.question: [[Beside]] experience, he has enthusiasm.
next:or:627.relatedInfo: besideは場所(そばに)を表す点で異なる。

next:or:628.hint: 彼女は会議の間、彼のそばに座っていた
next:or:628.fullSentence: She sat beside him during the meeting.
next:or:628.relatedInfo: besides(〜に加えて)とのスペルの違いに注意。

next:or:629.hint: 2つのものの間を表す前置詞
next:or:629.question: [[among]] Tokyo and Osaka
next:or:629.explanation: between A and B『AとBの間に』。

next:or:630.hint: 彼女は友人たちの中で安心を感じた
next:or:630.fullSentence: She felt safe among her friends.
next:or:630.explanation: among『〜の中で』。3つ以上のものの中にあることを表す。
next:or:630.relatedInfo: betweenは主に2者、amongは3者以上に使う。

next:or:631.hint: 出発点・起点を表す前置詞
next:or:631.question: He comes [[of]] Tokyo.
next:or:631.relatedInfo: 出身や出発点を表す基本的な前置詞。

next:or:632.hint: 騒音は別として、そのホテルは素晴らしかった
next:or:632.fullSentence: Apart from the noise, the hotel was excellent.
